auth_files.priority_hint: Use first sends requests to this account before the others, and Use last only when the others are unavailable. Use − and + for an exact order: the highest number is tried first.
auth_files.quota_weight_hint: How large this account's quota is next to others of the same provider, for pooled quota views. Claude plans count in Pro units: Pro 1, Max 5x 5, Max 20x 10, since a Max 20x weekly limit is only about twice a Max 5x's. Routing does not use it.
auth_files.quota_weight_invalid: Quota weight must be a number above 0 and at most 1000.

network.routing_order_hint: New sessions go to the credential that ranks first. Earlier criteria decide and later ones break ties. Existing sessions stay on their credential until it fails, so prompt caches stay warm.
network.routing_order_default: No criteria set; the default order applies: weekly reset, session remaining, priority.
network.routing_order_unknown: Not supported by this panel version; kept as configured
network.order_weekly_reset_hint: Weekly window that resets soonest, so expiring quota is used first
network.order_session_reset_hint: Short window (Claude five-hour) that resets soonest
network.order_weekly_remaining_hint: Most weekly quota left, scaled by quota weight
network.order_session_remaining_hint: Most short-window quota left, scaled by quota weight

quota_management.pool_history_off: History recording is off; projecting from live quota
quota_management.pool_history_unsupported: History is not recorded for this provider
quota_management.pool_no_accounts: No quota loaded for these accounts yet. Refresh all credentials to build the pool.
quota_management.usage_subtitle: Recorded by the server every minute
quota_management.usage_history_off: Usage history is off on the server, so per-account usage can't be shown.
quota_management.usage_read_failed: Couldn't read usage history. Trying again every minute.
quota_management.usage_read_failed_stale: Couldn't read usage history. Showing the last read; trying again every minute.
quota_management.usage_no_readings: No readings yet. The server records this account's usage every minute.
quota_management.usage_stale: No new readings for {{span}}. Showing the last recorded values.
quota_management.usage_meter_label: {{used}} used, steady use would be at {{pace}}
